svg.title: Đinh Quang Minh - Software Engineering student, AI and backend
svg.desc: Dinh Quang Minh (Đinh Quang Minh). Software Engineering student. Turning ideas into practical AI applications. Builds backend services and explores applications of LLMs. Based in Hanoi, Vietnam. Studying at FPT University, Japanese BrSE (Bridge SE) track. Training: AI in Action, VinUniversity. Focus: RAG, agentic workflows, real-time systems. Open to AI / Backend internships.
